confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on crowd-sourced Lugano price snapshots and Swiss restaurant price guides from 2025-2026, converted at roughly 1 CHF = 1.25 USD. Beer, coffee and meal figures are moderately reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain. Wine was bounded using the local relationship to beer, since sources say a glass of wine costs about the same as a pint. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Lugano and Ticino, not inspected listings. The FX observation (0.6720 for 18 November 2026) was taken from a third-party summary of the RBA table and not read directly from rba.gov.au. The RBA page is listed as the source URL, but the figure should be checked against it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lugano is priced as a Ticino lakeside tourist city within Switzerland. Food and drink use Swiss restaurant price guides, with Lugano set slightly below the Swiss national average. Accommodation is benchmarked to other mid-sized Swiss lakeside tourist towns, with the Swiss price level applied.
